headings.reviewNote: Gives equal effect to notarial acts performed anywhere under federal law by federal court officers, active-duty U.S. military officers, U.S. foreign service or consular officers, or other federally authorized persons.

headings.title: Prima facie evidence and authority for federal acts
headings.reviewNote: Treats the signature, title, and required seal under subsection 5 as prima facie evidence of genuineness and title, and conclusive authority except under subdivision (4).

headings.title: Effect of foreign and international notarial acts
headings.reviewNote: Gives equal effect to notarial acts performed under the authority of a foreign nation, its constituent units, or a multinational or international organization by authorized notaries, court officers, or other authorized persons.

headings.title: Prima facie evidence from foreign seal or stamp
headings.reviewNote: Treats the official seal or stamp under subsection 7 as prima facie evidence of genuine signature and indicated title, and conclusive authority except under subdivision (3).

headings.title: Conclusive foreign authority via legal digest
headings.reviewNote: Conclusively establishes foreign officer authority when indicated in law digests or customary reference sources.

headings.title: Conclusive authenticity established by apostille
headings.reviewNote: Conclusively establishes officer signature, seal, and position through an apostille under the Hague Convention.

headings.title: Conclusive authenticity established by consular certificate
headings.reviewNote: Conclusively establishes foreign notarial act authenticity through United States or foreign consular certification.

headings.title: Performance by Missouri notaries outside state restricted
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that Missouri notaries cannot perform acts outside Missouri without meeting host jurisdiction legal requirements.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 12 subsection headings for 486.775 governing in-state, other U.S. jurisdiction, federal, and foreign or international notarial acts, corresponding prima facie evidence and conclusive authority rules, digests, apostilles, consular certificates, and out-of-state limits on Missouri notaries.

headings.title: Ten-day address change notice and fee
headings.reviewNote: Requires sending written notice of residential, business, or mailing address change within ten days with a five-dollar fee.

headings.title: Prerequisites prior to performing acts after business change
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits notarial acts following a business address change until notice is delivered, confirmation received, and surety notified.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 486.780 governing address change notification procedures and operational prerequisites following business relocations.

headings.title: Ten-day name change notice and fee
headings.reviewNote: Requires sending written notice of legal name change within ten days accompanied by official documentation and a five-dollar fee.

headings.title: Continued use of former name and transition
headings.reviewNote: Mandates continuing to use former name until notice delivered, confirmation received, new seal obtained, and surety notified.

headings.title: Mandatory use of new name upon completion
headings.reviewNote: Requires the notary to use the new legal name once all statutory transition requirements are satisfied.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 486.785 governing legal name change reporting, transitional use of former name, and mandatory new name adoption.

headings.title: Written notice of commission resignation
headings.reviewNote: Requires a resigning notary to send signed written notice to the secretary indicating the effective resignation date.

headings.title: Mandatory resignation upon nonresidence or disability
headings.reviewNote: Mandates commission resignation if a notary ceases Missouri residence or employment, or becomes permanently disabled.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 486.790 establishing voluntary resignation notice procedures and mandatory resignation grounds.

headings.title: Mandatory seal destruction and journal disposition
headings.reviewNote: Requires destroying seals promptly and delivering journals to the secretary within thirty days of commission termination.

headings.title: Extended journal disposition period during reapplication
headings.reviewNote: Extends journal disposition deadline to three months for expiring notaries intending to reapply who have clean records.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 486.795 governing post-commission seal destruction and standard versus reapplication journal disposition timeframes.

headings.title: Civil liability of notary for damages
headings.reviewNote: Holds a notary liable to any person for all damages proximately caused by negligence, intentional violation of law, or official misconduct in relation to a notarization.

headings.title: Surety liability and bond ceiling
headings.reviewNote: Holds the surety liable for proximately caused damages up to the aggregate dollar amount of the bond.

headings.title: Employer liability for notary misconduct
headings.reviewNote: Holds an employer liable for damages if the employer directed, encouraged, approved, or tolerated notary misconduct.

headings.title: Employer liability to coerced employee notary
headings.reviewNote: Holds an employer liable to a notary for damages resulting from coerced violations or retaliation against the employee.

headings.title: Good-faith comprehension and volition determinations excluded
headings.reviewNote: Excludes good-faith determinations under section 486.645(1)(3) (comprehension) and (4) (volition) from the definition of negligence.

headings.title: Proximate cause requirement for damage recovery
headings.reviewNote: Requires proving that notary negligence, violation, or misconduct was a proximate cause of the claimed damages.

headings.title: Application to electronic and remote online notaries
headings.reviewNote: Extends liability provisions to electronic notaries and remote online notaries performing respective notarial acts.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 7 subsection headings for 486.805 governing civil liability of notaries, surety bond limits, employer vicarious liability, coercion protections, negligence safe harbors, causation standards, and electronic applicability.

headings.title: Discretionary revocation grounds
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the secretary to revoke a commission for any ground on which an application may be denied under section 486.605(4*) (source note flags that subsection "3" appears in original rolls).

headings.title: Mandatory revocation for nonresidence or unlawful status
headings.reviewNote: Mandates commission revocation for any notary who fails to maintain a Missouri residence or regular place of work or business and to maintain legal U.S. resident status.

headings.title: Pre-revocation notice and right of appeal
headings.reviewNote: Requires prior notice from the secretary stating revocation grounds and effective date unless an appeal is filed.

headings.title: Continuation of investigation despite termination
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the secretary to pursue notary investigations to conclusion and public record despite resignation or expiration.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority for revocation appeals
headings.reviewNote: Directs the secretary to promulgate rules governing administrative appeals from commission revocations.

headings.title: Application to electronic and remote online notaries
headings.reviewNote: Extends revocation standards and procedures to electronic notaries and remote online notaries.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsection headings for 486.810 governing discretionary revocation (preserving footnote noting subsection "3" appears in original rolls for section 486.605(4*)), mandatory revocation, pre-revocation notice, ongoing investigations, appeal rules, and electronic/remote applicability.

headings.title: Immediate emergency suspension upon certified notice
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes immediate commission suspension upon certified mail notice if public harm threatens, with prompt hearing.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority for suspension hearings and appeals
headings.reviewNote: Directs the secretary to promulgate rules governing hearing and appeal procedures for commission suspensions.

headings.title: Application to electronic and remote online notaries
headings.reviewNote: Extends emergency suspension procedures to electronic notaries and remote online notaries.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 486.815 governing emergency commission suspensions, administrative hearing rules, and electronic applicability.

headings.title: Application for Missouri notary commission required
headings.reviewNote: Requires a person to apply to be a commissioned Missouri notary prior to performing electronic notarial acts.

headings.title: Electronic capability registration required
headings.reviewNote: Requires registering electronic notarial capability with the secretary prior to performing electronic notarizations.

headings.title: Reregistration required upon recommissioning
headings.reviewNote: Mandates reregistering with the secretary before notarizing electronically after receiving a new commission.

headings.title: Simultaneous application and electronic registration permitted
headings.reviewNote: Permits simultaneous application for a notary commission and registration for electronic notarization capability.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 486.905 covering base commission requirements, initial electronic registration, recommissioning renewals, and joint applications.

headings.title: Mandatory electronic notary instruction and examination
headings.reviewNote: Requires completing an approved course and passing an examination before initial electronic notary registration.

headings.title: Curriculum content standards
headings.reviewNote: Requires instructional content to cover notarial laws, procedures, and ethics pertaining to electronic notarization.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 486.910 establishing training and testing requirements and curriculum standards for electronic notaries.

headings.title: Electronic registration form disclosures and attachments
headings.reviewNote: Specifies training proof, technical seal and signature descriptions, licensing data, and journal access instructions required.

headings.title: Multiple electronic signature and seal technologies permitted
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes registering one or more means for producing electronic signatures and seals concurrently or successively.

headings.title: Mandatory denial for material misstatements or omissions
headings.reviewNote: Mandates registration denial for any application containing a material misstatement or omission of fact.

headings.title: Confidentiality and closed-record protections
headings.reviewNote: Classifies registration form information as a closed record under chapter 610, limiting disclosure to authorized government agents, court orders, or the registrant or duly authorized agent.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 486.920 covering electronic registration disclosures, multiple technology registration, mandatory denial, and closed-record protections.

headings.title: Mandatory prerequisites for electronic notarization
headings.reviewNote: Requires principal presence, identity confirmation, understanding, voluntariness, communication, and signature attribution.

headings.title: Adherence to general notarial statutes
headings.reviewNote: Requires electronic notaries to comply with all applicable general notarial laws in performing electronic acts.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 486.930 establishing essential prerequisites for electronic notarizations and general statutory compliance.

headings.title: Completion of electronic notarial certificate
headings.reviewNote: Requires the electronic notary to properly complete an electronic notarial certificate for each electronic act.

headings.title: Required elements of electronic certificate
headings.reviewNote: Specifies certificate wording, registered electronic signature, and registered electronic notary seal elements.

headings.title: Permissible sources for certificate wording
headings.reviewNote: Establishes acceptable sources for electronic certificate wording, including statutory forms and out-of-state rules.

headings.title: Language and character readability standards
headings.reviewNote: Requires electronic certificates to be completed using letters, characters, and languages understood by the notary.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 486.935 covering electronic certificate completion, required contents, acceptable form sources, and language comprehension.

headings.title: Attachment and attribution of electronic credentials
headings.reviewNote: Requires attaching or associating a registered electronic signature and seal attributed to the commissioned notary.

headings.title: Required technical characteristics of electronic signature
headings.reviewNote: Specifies technical standards for electronic signatures, including uniqueness, verification, and tamper detection.

headings.title: Exclusive notary control over seal production means
headings.reviewNote: Requires maintaining sole control over the means of producing registered electronic notary seals at all times.

headings.title: Employer prohibitions regarding electronic credentials
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits employers from controlling, retaining, or using an employee's electronic signature or seal production devices.

headings.title: Non-notarial use of electronic signature permitted
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes using the electronic signature for other lawful purposes provided notarial title or status is omitted.

headings.title: Exclusive use of electronic seal for notarizations
headings.reviewNote: Restricts use of registered electronic seals or combined elements solely to lawful electronic notarizations.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsection headings for 486.940 establishing electronic signature and seal attachment standards, technical traits, exclusive control, employer bans, non-notarial signature use, and seal restrictions.

headings.title: Chronological bound journal maintenance requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires electronic notaries to maintain, protect, and provide for inspection a chronological bound journal with numbered pages.

headings.title: Dual maintenance of electronic and bound journals
headings.reviewNote: Requires an electronic notary to maintain an electronic journal and simultaneously record electronic acts in the bound journal.

headings.title: Single active bound journal limit and electronic backups
headings.reviewNote: Limits notaries to one active bound journal and requires retaining backup copies of electronic journals.

headings.title: Ten-year journal retention period
headings.reviewNote: Requires keeping the permanently bound journal for at least ten years from the date of the last entry.

headings.title: Required particulars for electronic journal entries
headings.reviewNote: Specifies mandatory entry details, including timestamp, act type, document description, parties, fees, and technology used.

headings.title: Prohibition against recording sensitive account numbers
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits recording Social Security numbers or credit card numbers in the electronic journal.

headings.title: Recording circumstances of uncompleted acts permitted
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes recording the circumstances for not performing or completing a requested electronic notarial act.

headings.title: Notation of certificate corrections required
headings.reviewNote: Requires appending a notation of the nature and date of certificate corrections to the corresponding journal entry.

headings.title: Technical and security capabilities of electronic journal
headings.reviewNote: Specifies two-factor authentication, tamper prevention, backup duplicate systems, and biometric capture capabilities.

headings.title: Compliance with statutory journal handling provisions
headings.reviewNote: Requires compliance with statutory rules regarding copying, security, surrender, and disposition of notarial journals.

headings.title: Read-only access authorization and instructions for secretary
headings.reviewNote: Requires providing and updating read-only journal access authorization and instructions for the secretary.

headings.title: Retention period and bound journal recording
headings.reviewNote: Mandates keeping electronic journal entries for at least ten years and recording electronic acts in a bound journal.

headings.title: Discretionary fee charging within statutory maximums
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes an electronic notary to charge up to statutory maximum fees, charge lower fees, or waive fees entirely.

headings.title: Maximum fee schedule for electronic notarial acts
headings.reviewNote: Establishes maximum fees of five dollars per signature for electronic acknowledgments, jurats, and witnessings.

headings.title: Requirements for advance travel fees
headings.reviewNote: Permits travel fees if agreed upon in advance and explained as separate and not mandated by law.

headings.title: Nondiscrimination in charging electronic fees
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits discrimination in fee charging while allowing fee waivers or reductions for humanitarian or charitable reasons.

headings.title: Application of employee notary rules to electronic acts
headings.reviewNote: Applies employer fee prohibitions and remittance requirements under section 486.695 to electronic notarizations.

headings.title: Conspicuous display of electronic fee schedule
headings.reviewNote: Requires conspicuous display of an English fee schedule in business locations, online sites, or presented directly to clients.

headings.title: Advance payment of electronic fees permitted
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes an electronic notary public to require payment of statutory fees prior to performing an electronic act.

headings.title: Conditions rendering advance fees nonrefundable
headings.reviewNote: Specifies when advance fees are nonrefundable upon completion or upon travel where acts could not lawfully proceed.

headings.title: Electronic certificate of authority for other jurisdictions
headings.reviewNote: Requires electronic evidence of authenticity for documents transmitted to another state or nation, if required, to be an electronic certificate of authority signed by the secretary conforming to pertinent U.S. international treaties.

headings.title: Logical association and tamper evidence of certificate
headings.reviewNote: Requires attaching or associating the certificate in a manner producing evidence of subsequent alterations.

headings.title: Statutory electronic certificate of authority form
headings.reviewNote: Prescribes the statutory text and wording for an electronic certificate of authority authenticating an electronic act.

headings.title: Five-business-day notice of email address change
headings.reviewNote: Requires electronically transmitting notice of an email address change secured by a registered electronic signature to the secretary within five business days.

headings.title: Ten-day notice of registration data or access changes
headings.reviewNote: Requires reporting any changes to registration data or electronic journal access instructions within ten days.

headings.title: Compromise or expiration of signature or seal means
headings.reviewNote: Requires immediate secretary notification, cessation of use, reregistration within thirty days, and software disposal upon compromise.

headings.title: Suspension and termination of electronic status
headings.reviewNote: Mandates immediate suspension of electronic status without alternative means and termination if not registered in thirty days.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 486.985 establishing notary duties upon credential compromise and mandatory administrative suspension or termination.

headings.title: Automatic termination of registration upon commission end
headings.reviewNote: Terminates electronic registration immediately upon revocation, resignation, expiration, or end of the notary commission.

headings.title: Independent survival of underlying commission
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that voluntary termination of electronic registration does not automatically terminate the underlying commission.

headings.title: Notice to secretary and credential disposal upon termination
headings.reviewNote: Requires written notice to the secretary and proper disposal of electronic signing credentials upon electronic termination.

headings.title: Expungement of credentials within thirty business days
headings.reviewNote: Requires the notary or duly authorized representative to permanently erase or expunge exclusive electronic seal, signature, or single-element software or devices within thirty business days of termination, expiration, resignation, revocation, or death.

headings.title: Recommissioning exception within three months
headings.reviewNote: Exempts former electronic notaries from expungement if recommissioned and reregistered within three months using the same means.
